description:
Turn raw signals into a per-requirement verdict. Reconcile each check: the authoritative verdict is the MCP-reported `success` (M4), NOT the agent exit code — reported true → satisfied (carry evidence); reported false → failed (carry evidence); no report (agent died) → failed. Then apply logical AND across the checks within each requirement to mark it satisfied/unsatisfied.
